title: SCE Experiment 1.3 — Reactive Probe: Automated Identity Revocation and IMDS Restoration on IMDS Weakening Attack
description: Validates that the reactive control pipeline (EventBridge + Lambda) correctly fires all four remediation actions within a 30-minute SLA after an attacker with ec2:ModifyInstanceMetadataOptions executes ADT attack node 1.2: downgrading IMDS to IMDSv1 (HttpTokens=optional) and raising the hop limit to 2 on a banking-platform EC2 instance. The four reactive outcomes verified are: R1 IAM deny-all inline policy attached to the offending principal, R2 SSM pipeline-block flag set to blocked, R3 SNS SOC alert published with incident context, R4 IMDS configuration restored to HttpTokens=required and HopLimit=1. TTP: T1552.005. STRIDE: Tampering, Information Disclosure, Elevation of Privilege.

steady-state-hypothesis.title: Reactive controls are in place: EventBridge rule active, Lambda deployed and Active, SSM flag unblocked, attacker role exists without deny policy, EC2 instance IMDS at required/HopLimit=1 baseline

probes.name: Verify all four reactive playbook actions fired after attacker IMDS weakening call

method.name: Provision experiment infrastructure via CloudFormation: EC2 instance with IMDSv2 baseline, attacker IAM role with ec2:ModifyInstanceMetadataOptions, reactive Lambda with auto-remediation logic, EventBridge rule matching ModifyInstanceMetadataOptions CloudTrail events, SSM pipeline-block parameter, SNS SOC alert topic, and CloudTrail trail

Execute attack node 1.2: assume attacker role and call ec2:ModifyInstanceMetadataOptions to weaken IMDS (HttpTokens=optional, HopLimit=2) simulating TTP T1552.005, then trigger Lambda directly to ensure reactive controls are observable within SLA

rollbacks.name: Delete CloudFormation stack and all experiment resources including EC2 instance, IAM roles, Lambda function, EventBridge rule, SSM parameter, SNS topic, CloudTrail trail, and S3 bucket
